protocol_summary.name: Poof (a.k.a. PoofCash / Poof protocol on Celo)

generations.v1_2021-10: Shielded zk 'debt' tokens (PoofMintableLendable): mint/burn require zk proofs (bytes[3] _proofs + account tree/verifier). Not mintable/redeemable by unprivileged holders without valid shielded-account proofs.
generations.v2_2021-12: PToken (plain ERC20 with supplyManagers) plus V1Migration (whitelist-gated) converting v1->v2 1:1.
generations.poofcash_token: POOF ERC20 (100M) deployed 2021-07-03 via SingletonFactory; used for release/vesting (ReleasePOOF contract, Timelock). Trades at ~$0.00002.

protocol_summary.status_2026: Dead as a protocol. v1 shielded debt token contracts report debtToken.totalSupply()==0 and no underlying(); v2 tokens (PToken) can only be minted by privileged supply managers. The v2 supply manager EOA 0x14874877865e659F09D9CE7c943C89aEB20F2bb5 was active as recently as 2026-06-18 minting pUSD(v2) and burning pUSD held by Mobius pool 0xa2F0e57d (privileged, not unprivileged).
